name: Stage Winner Gap Seconds
expression: AVERAGEX('Result', VAR s='Result'[Stage] VAR winner=CALCULATE(MIN('Result'[Adjusted Seconds]),REMOVEFILTERS('Rider'),REMOVEFILTERS('Result'),'Result'[Stage]=s,'Result'[Position]=1) RETURN 'Result'[Adjusted Seconds]-winner)
description: Mean adjusted-time gap to the rider placed first; can be negative after adjustments.

name: Speed Proxy kmh
description: Distance / raw finish hours. Teams use summed rider-distance / summed rider-time, not summed speeds.

name: Mountain Cumulative Seconds
expression: IF(HASONEVALUE('Rider'[Bib]) && NOT ISBLANK([GC Rank]), VAR s=[As of Stage Number] RETURN CALCULATE(SUM('Result'[Adjusted Seconds]),FILTER(ALL('Stage'),'Stage'[Stage]<=s && 'Stage'[Stage Type]="Mountain")))

name: Mountain GC Proxy Rank
expression: VAR t=[Mountain Cumulative Seconds] VAR field=FILTER(ALL('Rider'),NOT ISBLANK(CALCULATE([Mountain Cumulative Seconds]))) RETURN IF(NOT ISBLANK(t),RANKX(field,[Mountain Cumulative Seconds],t,ASC,Skip))
description: Time-only mountain proxy, distinct from KOM points.

name: Young GC at Race Start Rank
expression: VAR t=[Rider Cumulative Seconds] VAR age=SELECTEDVALUE('Rider'[Age at Race Start]) VAR field=FILTER(ALL('Rider'),'Rider'[Age at Race Start]<26 && NOT ISBLANK(CALCULATE([Rider Cumulative Seconds]))) RETURN IF(NOT ISBLANK(t) && age<26,RANKX(field,[Rider Cumulative Seconds],t,ASC,Skip))
description: Under 26 on the first stage date; separate from the original calendar-year Young Rider rule.

name: GC Rank Change
expression: VAR s=SELECTEDVALUE('Stage'[Stage]) VAR nowRank=[GC Trace Rank] VAR prior=CALCULATE(MAX('Standing'[GC Rank]),REMOVEFILTERS('Stage'),'Standing'[Stage]=s-1) RETURN IF(NOT ISBLANK(nowRank) && NOT ISBLANK(prior),prior-nowRank)
description: Positive = places gained; blank on first stage or after exit.

name: Top Ten Position
expression: VAR pos=[Stage Position] RETURN IF(NOT ISBLANK(pos) && pos<=10,pos)

name: Cumulative Bonus Seconds
expression: VAR s=[As of Stage Number] RETURN CALCULATE([Bonus Seconds],FILTER(ALL('Stage'),'Stage'[Stage]<=s))

name: Cumulative Penalty Seconds
expression: VAR s=[As of Stage Number] RETURN CALCULATE([Penalty Seconds],FILTER(ALL('Stage'),'Stage'[Stage]<=s))

name: Scenario Seconds
expression: VAR t=[Rider Cumulative Seconds] VAR mode=SELECTEDVALUE('Scenario'[Scenario],"Official adjusted") RETURN IF(NOT ISBLANK(t),t+IF(mode IN {"No bonuses","No bonuses or penalties"},[Cumulative Bonus Seconds],0)-IF(mode IN {"No penalties","No bonuses or penalties"},[Cumulative Penalty Seconds],0))

name: Scenario GC Rank
expression: VAR t=[Scenario Seconds] VAR field=FILTER(ALL('Rider'),NOT ISBLANK(CALCULATE([Scenario Seconds]))) RETURN IF(NOT ISBLANK(t),RANKX(field,[Scenario Seconds],t,ASC,Skip))

name: Scenario Rank Change
expression: IF(NOT ISBLANK([GC Rank]),[GC Rank]-[Scenario GC Rank])

name: Top Ten Movement
expression: VAR a=[GC Rank] VAR b=[Scenario GC Rank] RETURN IF(NOT ISBLANK(a),SWITCH(TRUE(),a>10 && b<=10,"Entered top 10",a<=10 && b>10,"Left top 10",a<=10,"Stayed top 10","Outside top 10"))

name: Country Best GC Rank
expression: VAR s=[As of Stage Number] RETURN CALCULATE(MIN('Standing'[GC Rank]),REMOVEFILTERS('Stage'),'Standing'[Stage]=s,KEEPFILTERS(TREATAS(VALUES('Country'[Country]),'Rider'[Rider Country])))
